decision_record.mechanism: Stale inputs / execution: with a dead bars feed the sleeve kept entering days later, sized and priced off the stale close; the gate refuses entries whose newest bar is >7 days old (longest legitimate gap, Fri bar read Tue after a Mon holiday, is ~4.4 days). Exits are never filtered.
decision_record.transfer: The sleeve's designed daily-bar edge (signal on the last completed bar) is paid only when that bar is current; a stale bar's close is no longer the market the order will fill in.
